title: #[non_exhaustive] missing from filter condition structs
description: In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/query.rs, EmailFilterCondition is a public struct but lacks #[non_exhaustive]. In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/submission.rs, EmailSubmissionFilterCondition also lacks #[non_exhaustive]. The RFC may add new filter fields in future; without #[non_exhaustive], adding fields to these structs is a semver-breaking change for any code outside this crate that constructs them via struct literal syntax. Compare: EmailSubmission, Envelope, Address, DeliveryStatus in submission.rs all have #[non_exhaustive]. EmailComparator in query.rs also lacks #[non_exhaustive]. The pattern in the codebase is to mark all public structs #[non_exhaustive]; the filter condition structs are inconsistent with this. Note: #[non_exhaustive] + Default derive requires callers to use ..Default::default() in struct literals — already done in the tests (line 239, 244, 248 in query.rs tests), so this is already compatible.
